scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Milk, Cheese,
Old Frying Pans,
Pieces of Cake...
Th-that's everything
I need to make lunch for
my friends in the Factory!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
牛奶，
奶酪，
破旧平底锅，
小蛋糕...
这、这些就是给工厂里的朋友做午餐所需的全部东西了！

scripts.text: Well, I did promise to help you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我答应过要帮你的

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Finally, I can treat my
buddies to a wonderful
feast! They'll be so pleased!
Oh, I'd really like to repay you
somehow, but I'm not sure
what I could possibly give...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了，我终于可以请我的伙伴们享用一顿丰盛的午餐了！
他们一定会很开心的！
啊，我真想好好报答你，但我不确定能给你什么...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Of course! Why don't
you treat yourself to
my specialty, Kasis's
Crunch Toast? It looks
simple, but it actually
requires great skill to make.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
有了！
不如尝尝我的拿手好菜，卡西斯特制土司？
看着简单，做起来可很考验手艺。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Here you are!
Please enjoy this and always
remember that breakfast is the
most important meal of the day!
Now, I better prepare those
lunches. Goodbye, my friend~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
给你！
好好享用，可要记住，早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！
我该去准备午餐了。
再见，我的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Oh...
Oh, I'm so sorry.
I must have confused
you with someone else.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
啊...
啊，真对不起。
我一定是把你和别的人搞混了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
You see, I've been asking
adventurers that have been
passing through to provide
me with food supplies so that
I can make lunch for my friends
that are working in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你看，我一直在请求路过的冒险者为我提供食材，这样我就能为在艾音布罗克工厂工作的朋友们做午餐了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Yes...
So...
Sorry...
To... Bother you.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
嗯...
那个...
对不起...
打扰...你了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs if entranced,
Kasis continues to
stare at the Milk, Cheese
Old Frying Pans and Pieces
of Cake that you are carrying.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF卡西斯仿佛着了魔一般，一直盯着你携带的牛奶、奶酪、破旧平底锅和小蛋糕看。^000000

scripts.text: You can have these if you want.
scripts.translation: 如果你想要的话，这些给你吧

scripts.text: Um, why are you staring?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你为什么一直盯着看？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Really? Is it alright
with you for me to have
all of this Milk, Cheese,
Pieces of Cake and these
Old Frying Pans? Oh, bless
your kind heart, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
真的吗？你愿意把这些牛奶、奶酪、小蛋糕和破旧平底锅都给我吗？
啊，谢谢你，心地善良的冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Finally, I can treat my
buddies to a wonderful
feast! They'll be so pleased!
Oh, I'd really like to repay you
somehow, but I'm not sure
what I could possibly give...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了，我终于可以请我的伙伴们享用一顿丰盛的午餐了！
他们一定会很开心的！
啊，我真想好好报答你，但我不确定能给你什么...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Of course! Why don't
you treat yourself to
my specialty, Kasis's
Crunch Toast? It looks
simple, but it actually
requires great skill to make.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
有了！
不如尝尝我的拿手好菜，卡西斯特制土司？
看着简单，做起来可很考验手艺。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Here you are!
Please enjoy this and always
remember that breakfast is the
most important meal of the day!
Now, I better prepare those
lunches. Goodbye, my friend~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
给你！
好好享用，可要记住，早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！
我该去准备午餐了。
再见，我的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Oh, let me apologize
again. But I can't help
but admire the quality of
your goods. Er, you know,
the food you're carrying. I'm
a chef by trade, after all.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
啊，真是对不起。
可你这些东西的品质，实在让我忍不住多看两眼。
呃，就是你带着的那些食物。
毕竟我是厨师嘛。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm sorry, but we're closed
right now. Unfortunately, we
don't have any more bread
in stock. ^333333*Siiiiiiiiigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
抱歉，现在不营业。
面包已经没有存货了。
^333333*Siiiiiiiiigh...*^000000

scripts.text: Is something wrong?
scripts.translation: 出什么事了吗？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Well, my current contract
with the company that's been
providing me with ingredients
has expired. Of course, it's
bad enough that I don't have
the food to run this business.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
给我供应食材的那家公司，合同已经到期了。
店里没了食材，做不了生意，就已经够糟心的了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
But I also feel like I'm
letting my friends down.
You see, I've been sending
them lunch every day since
they've been working in the
Factory over in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
可更让我难受的是，好像辜负了那些朋友。
自从他们去艾音布罗克的工厂干活，我每天都会给他们送午餐。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm unable to make
lunch for them at the
moment, but I really want to
help my buddies, especially
since their financial situation
seems pretty bad right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我现在无法为他们做午餐了，但我真的很想帮助我的伙伴们，特别是他们现在的经济状况似乎很糟糕。

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我帮你吗？

scripts.text: I'm so sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 真让人难过

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Sure, I'm willing to accept
help from wherever I can find
it. If you would, I'd like you to bring me some food supplies
that I can use to make lunches
for my friends at the Factory.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
愿意帮忙就太好了，不管是谁，我都很感激。
能不能帮我带点食材，好让我给工厂里的朋友做午餐？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Would you
please get me
^4D4DFF50 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Cheese^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Pieces of Cake^000000 and
^4D4DFF50 Old Frying Pans^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
能帮我弄来这些东西吗？
^4D4DFF50瓶牛奶^000000，
^4D4DFF50块奶酪^000000，
^4D4DFF50个小蛋糕^000000，
以及^4D4DFF50个破旧平底锅^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'd really appreciate
your help. My friends seem
so depressed to be working
in the Factory and I want to
do all I can to cheer them up.
Thanks for your kind offer~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
有你帮忙，真是太好了。
朋友们在工厂里似乎干得很不开心，我想尽量让他们高兴一点。
谢谢你愿意帮忙~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm trying to renew
my contract with the
company that's been
providing me with food
supplies, but it hasn't
been working out so far...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我正在尝试与一直为我提供食材的公司续约，但到目前为止进展不太顺利...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I don't know what's
happening, but hopefully
I can find a new supplier
soon. There are my friends
to worry about, as well as
the sake of my business.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
也不知道怎么回事，但愿能尽快找到新供应商。
朋友们让我放心不下，店里的生意也得顾着。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Anyway, please come
again. Hopefully, we'll
have some good bread
in stock next time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
总之，下次再来吧。
希望到时店里又有好吃的面包了，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
Wait! Don't say
anything! You must be
an adventurer from the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
So... I'm right, aren't I?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的家伙]
等等！别说话！你一定是来自卢恩·米德加兹王国的冒险者！
所以...我猜对了吧？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: How did you know?
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道的？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Allow me to
introduce myself.
My name is Morris Poe,
detective of great acclaim
and world wide fame.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
容我自我介绍。
我叫莫里斯·坡，是一位名扬四海、备受赞誉的大侦探。

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我从未听说过你

scripts.text: You're kidding me.
scripts.translation: 你在开玩笑吧

scripts.text: I'm outta here.
scripts.translation: 我要走了

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Morris Poe?
Renown detective?
Advocate for justice in
the Schwarzwald Republic?
Surely you recognize one
of my esteemed titles.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
莫里斯·坡？
名侦探？
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的正义使者？
这些响当当的名号，你总该听过一个吧。

scripts.text: Nope, I don't know you.
scripts.translation: 不，我不认识你

scripts.text: You're Morris Poe?!
scripts.translation: 你是莫里斯·坡？！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
You don't...?
But I'm a famous hero.
Children look up to me
and wish they'd grow
up to be as smart as me.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
没听过...？
可我明明是个大英雄啊。
孩子们都崇拜我，盼着长大后能像我一样聪明。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
I don't get it.
I'm famouser than
that. A household name
even. I've got a sterling
public image, how could
you never have heard of me...?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
真搞不懂。
我明明很有名，简直家喻户晓。
形象又这么光辉，你怎么可能没听说过我...？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Kidding? Ha ha!
Look at these keen,
deductive and deeply
analytical eyes and
tell me I'm joking.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
开玩笑？
哈哈！
看着我这双敏锐、善于推理又洞察一切的眼睛，你还敢说我在开玩笑？

scripts.text: Whoa, those ARE keen eyes.
scripts.translation: 哇，那确实是双敏锐的眼睛

scripts.text: Okay. You're joking.
scripts.translation: 好吧。你在开玩笑

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, this sharp,
penetrating, yet
highly intelligent gaze
belongs to the world
detective and crime
fighter, Morris Poe!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
没错，这锐利、透彻又充满智慧的目光，正属于世界名侦探、罪恶克星莫里斯·坡！

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我从未听说过你

scripts.text: Golly, Morris Poe?!
scripts.translation: 天哪，莫里斯·坡？！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Never heard of...?
Impossible! If there are
two things I hate more
than crime, they would be
dishonesty... And rejection
from beautiful women.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
没听说过...？
不可能！
要说有什么比犯罪更让我厌恶，那就是撒谎...还有被美女拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
When you get over your
sense of pride and gain
a little maturity, then we
might share an actual
conversation. Until then,
you'll just have to grow up.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
等你放下那点自尊，变得成熟些，咱们也许才能好好谈一谈。
在那之前，你还是先学着长大吧。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahahahahaah--Huh.
If there are two things
I hate more than criminals,
they would be sarcasm...
And receiving fake phone
numbers from really cute girls.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
Hahahahahaah--哼。
要说有什么比罪犯更让我厌恶，那就是挖苦...还有可爱姑娘给我的假电话号码。

scripts.text: Yeah, you're no Don Juan.
scripts.translation: 是啊，你可不是唐·璜

scripts.text: I'm... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我...我很抱歉

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Wah...!
Did you just--?!
Ugh, you're the worst
type of person, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
Wah...!
你刚才竟敢...？！
啧，你知道吗，你就是最让人讨厌的那种人！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
I think it's too late to
apologize. Why would you
treat someone of my stature
with such caustic sarcasm?!
What excuse could possibly
exonerate your behavior?!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
现在道歉，恐怕太晚了。
对我这样的人物，怎么能如此冷嘲热讽？！
你倒说说，能拿什么借口为自己开脱？！

scripts.text: I... I was intimidated...
scripts.translation: 我...我很害怕...

scripts.text: It's how I treat all losers.
scripts.translation: 这就是我对所有失败者的态度

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Of course: intense feelings
of awe and fear of my vast
intellect would result in that
kind of deviant behavior. I'll
have to forgive you, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
原来如此，被我的过人才智震慑，心生敬畏和恐惧，才会举止反常。
看来我也只能原谅你了。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
What...?!
Morris Poe, a loser?
Such defamatory remarks
cannot be forgiven, no
matter how unfounded
and groundless they are!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
什么...？！
莫里斯·坡是个失败者？
不管这种诽谤多么毫无根据，我都绝不原谅！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahaha, oh, that's
funny. Wait. You're...
You're really leaving.
N-no, come baaaack!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
Hahaha，真会开玩笑。
等等，你...你真要走？
别、别走，回来呀！

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
How did I know?
Elementary, my friend.
There was an abundance
of clues for me to make
that sort of simple deduction.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的家伙]
怎么知道的？
小意思，我的朋友。
线索多得很，做出这点简单的推理，易如反掌。

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
Hello...?
...............
Oh, this is embarassing.
I can't believe I'm getting
the silent treatment...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的家伙]
喂...？
...............
唉，太丢脸了。
我居然被人晾在一边...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, I know it's
difficult to believe that
you would be fortunate
enough to stand in the
presence of genius. Now,
you must be wondering...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
没错，居然有幸亲眼见到天才，确实令人难以置信。
现在，你一定在想...

scripts.text: Um, wondering what?
scripts.translation: 嗯，在想什么？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
You're wondering,
"How in the world
can I be as brilliant
as Morris Poe, the
genius detective?"
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你在想，“我怎么可能像天才侦探莫里斯·坡一样聪明？”

scripts.text:
[Morris]
First, I think it's fair
to let you know that it's
an impossible dream. Men like
myself only arise in this world
perhaps once every generation.
I'm sorry, but don't give up!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
首先，我得坦白告诉你：这个梦想是不可能实现的。
像我这样的人物，一代也许才出一个。
真遗憾，不过别灰心！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Now, you can try to reach
a level of intelligence that
is comparable to my own by
joining the Young Detective's
Club. To become a member, you just need one essential article.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你可以加入少年侦探社，努力让自己的智力接近我。
要成为社员，只缺一样必备的东西。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, you will need the
^0000FFRenown Detective's Cap^000000!
Luckily, I'm giving them
away for a relatively small
material cost, but you must
hurry while supplies last.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
是的，你需要^0000FF侦探之帽^000000！
幸运的是，我只收取相对低廉的材料费，但你要抓紧，数量有限。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Simply bring me
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. That's all!

[Morris]
But first, let me warn you
not to bring a ^FF0000slotted Bucket
Hat with a card compounded to
it, or any upgraded Bucket Hats. I'm not responsible for any
loss resulting from that.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
不过先提醒你，别拿^FF0000插过卡或精炼过的带孔软呢帽来。
因此造成的损失，我概不负责。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hurry and bring me
those items! There are
only 20,000,000 Renown
Detective Caps left!
Once they're gone,
they'll be extinct!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
快把那些物品带给我！
只剩下20,000,000顶侦探之帽了！
一旦卖完，就绝版了！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
So, did you want to
buy, er, receive this
Renown Detective's Cap
and become an honored
member of the Young
Detective's Club?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
那么，你是想购买，呃，领取这顶侦探之帽，并成为少年侦探社的荣誉成员吗？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember, make sure
that you don't bring any
^FF0000slotted Bucket Hats that
have been upgraded or have
cards compounded to them, or
you'll lose those enhancements^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
记住，^FF0000别拿精炼过或插过卡的带孔软呢帽来，否则精炼效果和卡片都会损失^000000。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Now, if you have only
1 Bucket Hat, we can begin.
Young Detective's Club... Salute!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，只要身上仅带着1顶软呢帽，就可以开始了。
少年侦探社...敬礼！

scripts.text: Salute.
scripts.translation: 敬礼

scripts.text: Whatever...
scripts.translation: 随便吧...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great, done like a pro!
Now, I need to check your
fee--I mean qualifications.
Let's see now, I need to
look through your Inventory...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好，真有模有样！
接下来检查你的费用...我是说，资格。
嗯，得看看你的物品栏...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Wait. You don't have
enough Magnifiers. You
do want to join this club,
don't you? Did you need to
hear the requirements again?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
等等。你的放大镜不够。
你是想加入这个社团的，对吧？需要我再说一遍要求吗？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Not enough Tassels? Check.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜，确认。
流苏不足，确认。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Hm. You're missing
the slotted Bucket Hat.
You were so close...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜，确认。
流苏...确认。
嗯，少了带孔软呢帽。
明明就差一点了...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Hey. Where's the zeny?!
That's the most important,
er, qualification of all!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜，确认。
流苏...确认。
带孔软呢帽，有了。
喂，Zeny呢？！
那可是最重要的...呃，资格！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 You need
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. That's all!

[Morris]
Now, remember everything
that you need this time, okay?
I'll be waiting to welcome
you into the elite ranks of 
the Young Detective's Club.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
现在，这次记住你需要的所有东西，好吗？
我会在这里等待，欢迎你加入少年侦探社的精英行列。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Aaaand zeny. Heh heh. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜，确认。
流苏...确认。
带孔软呢帽，有了。
还——有Zeny。
Heh heh.
完美。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great, that's everything!
Welcome to the club! Here's
your Renown Detective's Cap,
so wear it with pride as you
take an active part in our club's
activities and promotion!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好，都齐了！
欢迎入社！
这是你的侦探之帽，要自豪地戴上它，积极参加社里的活动和宣传！

scripts.text: Wait, promotion?
scripts.translation: 等等，宣传？

scripts.text: Hooray!
scripts.translation: 万岁！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Of course, isn't it obvious?
As a member, one of your duties
will be to sing accolades of this club so that more members
will join and earn their own
Renown Detective's Caps.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
当然，这还用说？
社员的职责之一，就是大力夸赞本社，让更多人加入，也拥有自己的侦探之帽。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Alright, scurry off
now and proudly display
your new, rakishly stylish
Renown Detective's Cap
to all of your friends!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，快去吧！
向你的朋友们炫耀一下你那顶崭新、潇洒又帅气的侦探之帽吧！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Alright, scurry off
now and proudly display
your new, rakishly stylish
Renown Detective's Cap
to all of your friends!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，快去吧！
向你的朋友们炫耀一下你那顶崭新、潇洒又帅气的侦探之帽吧！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Huh. You just failed
the "Test of Respect."
You don't deserve the
honor of wearing the
Renowned Detective's Cap!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哼，你没通过“尊重测试”。
你不配戴上侦探之帽！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Have you come to me
in order to obtain another
Renown Detective's Cap?
I realize that such a stylish
headgear is in high demand.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你是来找我再获取一顶侦探之帽的吗？
我知道这种时尚的头饰非常抢手。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember, make sure
that you don't bring any
^FF0000slotted Bucket Hats that
have been upgraded or have
cards compounded to them, or
you'll lose those enhancements^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
记住，^FF0000别拿精炼过或插过卡的带孔软呢帽来，否则精炼效果和卡片都会损失^000000。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
As a proud member of
the Young Detective's Club,
did you bring everything
you need in order to earn
a Renown Detective's Cap?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
作为少年侦探社自豪的一员，你带齐了获得侦探之帽所需的所有东西了吗？

scripts.text: I'm not sure~
scripts.translation: 我不太确定~

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
What...?! Every good
detective must have a
photographic memory
and be able to recall
minute details in order
to crack the case.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
什么...？！
优秀的侦探都该过目不忘，连细枝末节也记得清清楚楚，这样才能破案。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember...
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. Okay?

[Morris]
Great!
Now let me just
check to see if you
brought everything...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好！
现在让我检查一下你是否带齐了所有东西...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hmm, you don't have
enough Magnifiers? But
those are essential tools
for sleuthing. Come now,
hurry back with them!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
嗯，你的放大镜不够吗？但那是侦探必不可少的工具。
快去吧，赶紧把它们带回来！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Not enough Tassels? Check.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜，确认。
流苏不足，确认。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Hm. You're missing
the slotted Bucket Hat.
You were so close...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜，确认。
流苏...确认。
嗯，少了带孔软呢帽。
明明就差一点了...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Hey. Where's the zeny?!
That's the most important,
er, qualification of all!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜，确认。
流苏...确认。
带孔软呢帽，有了。
喂，Zeny呢？！
那可是最重要的...呃，资格！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember...
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. Okay?

[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Aaaand zeny. Heh heh. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜，确认。
流苏...确认。
带孔软呢帽，有了。
还——有Zeny。
Heh heh.
完美。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great! You've just qualified
to own yet another Renowned
Detective's Cap. Congratulations! Now, let me collect all of these
goods and zeny from you...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好！你刚刚获得了拥有另一顶侦探之帽的资格。
恭喜！现在，让我把这些物品和Zeny收起来...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahaha! It's what
I expect from one of
our Junior Gold Members!
How does it feel like to be
the cream of the cream of
the crop? Great, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
Hahaha!
不愧是我们的初级黄金会员！
当上精英中的精英，感觉如何？
棒极了吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hello, mister!
Um, would you do
me a favor, please?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你好，先生！
那个，能请你帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hello, ma'am!
Um, would you do
me a favor, please?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你好，女士！
那个，能请你帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh! You brought me
some Royal Jelly to
eat, as well as everything
I need to make a Baby Pacifier.
Okay, let me get started on that right away. Just a moment...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦！你不仅带来了给我吃的蜂胶，连做小孩奶嘴的材料也都齐了。
好，我马上动手，等一下...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Damn.
That Royal Jelly
was frickin' delicious!
Now I can make your
Baby Pacifier. Let's see
here. Ah, here we go...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
靠，这蜂胶真他妈好吃！
这下可以给你做小孩奶嘴了。
让我瞧瞧，啊，就这样...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
It's done!
Now, you're the
proud owner of your
very own Baby Pacifier!
I hope you're happy with
yourself. Travel safe, okay?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
做好了！
现在你也有自己的小孩奶嘴啦，是不是很神气？
希望你满意。
路上小心哦？

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什么？

scripts.text: Sorry, kid...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，小家伙...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Well, my mom has been
sick recently, so both of
us haven't been able to eat
for the past few days. But
if she doesn't eat, how does
she expect to get better?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯，我妈妈最近生病了，所以我们好几天都没吃东西了。
但如果她不吃东西，怎么能好起来呢？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
So I guess what I'm
asking is, would you be
able to spare some food?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
所以我想问的是，你能分我一点食物吗？

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 帮助他

scripts.text: Refuse to help.
scripts.translation: 拒绝帮助

scripts.text:
[Kid]
If you would, do you think
you can get some Royal Jelly
that I can give to my mom? The old lady next door says that it's
really nutritious and helps you get better faster if you're sick.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
如果可以的话，你能帮我弄点蜂胶吗？
我想给我妈妈吃。
隔壁的老太太说，蜂胶营养很好，生病的时候吃了能好得快一些。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
My mom would be mad
at me if she found out
I was begging for it, but
Royal Jelly is too expensive
for me to get without any help!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
如果我妈妈知道我在求人帮忙，她肯定会生气的，但蜂胶对我来说太贵了，不靠别人我根本买不起！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh, would it be alright
if I have this Royal Jelly?
It would really help my mom
feel better. Thanks so much~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊，那我可以收下这个蜂胶吗？
它真的能让我妈妈感觉好一些。太感谢了~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey, to pay you back, why
don't I make a Baby Pacifier
for you? I learned how to make
one when my baby brother was
born. But first, I'll need some
materials to put it together...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿，为了报答你，我为你做一个小孩奶嘴吧？
我弟弟出生时，我学会了怎么做。
不过首先，我需要一些材料来组装它...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Would you
please bring
^3131FF1 Nursing Bottle^000000,
^3131FF1 Nose Ring^000000 and
^3131FF1 Pacifier^000000? Oh, and one
more ^3131FFRoyal Jelly^000000 for me~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
请带这些来，好吗？
^3131FF1个婴儿的奶瓶^000000，
^3131FF1个牛鼻环^000000，
还有^3131FF1个小孩奶嘴^000000。
哦，再给我带一个^3131FF蜂胶^000000~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh... Um, that's
alright. Maybe I was
asking too much from
you. I mean, it's true
that you barely know me...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦...嗯，没关系。也许是我要求太多了。
毕竟，你几乎不认识我...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Th-that's okay.
I guess you must
be so busy that you
don't even have the
time to listen to some
little boy's problems...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
没、没关系。
你肯定特别忙，连听小孩子诉苦的时间都没有...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Oh, hello, what's this?
You're carrying 1 Black
Dyestuffs, 1 Frozen Rose,
999 Tiger Panties and even
50,000 zeny with you. That's
enough to make a Winter Hat...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
哦，你好，这是什么？
你身上带着1个黑色染料、1朵冰雕玫瑰、999条老虎内裤，甚至还有50,000 Zeny。
这些足够做一顶时尚防寒帽了...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Um, would you mind letting
me have those items so that
I can make a Winter Hat?
I'd never be able to gather
those things on my own...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
嗯，你介意把这些材料给我吗？
这样我就能做一顶时尚防寒帽了。
我自己根本凑不齐这些东西...

scripts.text: Let her have the items.
scripts.translation: 把材料给她

scripts.text: Don't give her the items.
scripts.translation: 不给材料

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Oh, thank you so much!
I've always wanted to make
this hat and try it on, even
if it's just once. But don't
worry, I'll give it to you~
Now please next; a moment...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
啊，太感谢了！
我一直想亲手做一顶，再戴上试试，哪怕只试一次也好。
放心，最后会交给你的~
请稍等片刻...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Let's see...
I've got to fold
the rose like this...
Be careful with the dye...
Where did I put all those
pan--Oh, here we are.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
让我想想...
玫瑰要这样折...
染料可得小心...
那些内裤放哪儿了...哦，在这儿。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
^333333*Whew!*^000000
Finally, it's done!
Now, if you don't mind,
let me try this hat on
for just a little while.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
^333333*呼！*^000000
终于做好了！
如果你不介意，就让我戴一小会儿吧。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Ahhhhhh~
It just feels...
I felt so free~
It was everything
I imagined it to be.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
Ahhhhhh~
这感觉...
好自由啊~
跟我想的一模一样。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Here, please take
this Winter Hat. I really
hope that you'll enjoy it
as much as I do. Well then,
be safe in your travels, okay?
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
请收下这顶时尚防寒帽。
我真的希望你能像我一样喜欢它。
那么，旅途平安，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
I'm sorry, I know that
I was asking a pretty big
favor from someone I just
met. I hope you understand
how much I really want to
make that Winter Hat...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
抱歉，才刚认识，就求你帮这么大的忙。
但愿你能明白，我实在太想做一顶时尚防寒帽了...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Look at that blue
sky. Don't you wish
you could just soar
through the heavens
with your own wings?
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
看那片蓝天。
你不希望能长出翅膀，在天空中翱翔吗？

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Of course, it's an
impossible dream,
but with this Winter Hat,
you can at least enjoy the
sensation of freedom that
a bird in flight must feel.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
当然，这是一个不可能的梦想，但戴上这顶时尚防寒帽，你至少能感受到鸟儿飞翔时那种自由的感觉。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
If you would like
a hat like this, I would
need to have some items
that I don't think I can ever
obtain on my very own.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
如果你也想要一顶，就得准备一些材料。
那些东西，我自己恐怕永远也凑不齐。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
^FF00001 Black Dyestuffs^000000,
^FF0000999 Tiger Panties^000000,
^FF00001 Frozen Rose^000000 and
^FF000050,000 zeny^000000. If you can
bring those to me, I shall
make you a Winter Hat.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
^FF00001个黑色染料^000000，
^FF0000999条老虎内裤^000000，
^FF00001朵冰雕玫瑰^000000，
以及^FF000050,000 Zeny^000000。
把这些带来，我就给你做一顶时尚防寒帽。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
The white rose, in its
purity and simplicity, is
like a woman who doesn't
need jewels or fancy dresses
to look noble and beautiful. It's the perfect gift for a lady.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
白玫瑰以其纯洁与简约，宛如一位无需珠宝或华服便能显得高贵美丽的淑女。
它是送给女士的完美礼物。

scripts.text: Make a Mystic Rose.
scripts.translation: 制作水灵玫瑰

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Ah, I see that you've brought
what I need to bleach the blood
red hue from these Witherless
Roses and adorn these flowers
with eternal elegance. May I use these items to make a Mystic Rose?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
啊，看来您带来了我需要的材料，可以将这些永恒玫瑰上的血红褪去，赋予花朵永恒的优雅。
我可以开始制作水灵玫瑰了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Thank you. Please
next; a moment while
I concentrate in order to
preserve the natural beauty
of these gorgeous flowers...
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
谢谢。
请稍等，我要集中精神，留住这些花朵天然的美丽...

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
The rose truly is the
undisputed queen of all
flowers. All other flora must
humbly bow to its regal beauty.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
玫瑰是当之无愧的百花之王。
其他花卉在它高贵的美面前，都只能俯首称臣。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
There, it is finished.
Please remember to wear
your hair in an elegant and
refined manner when wearing
the Mystic Rose so as not to disgrace these beautiful flowers.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
好了，完成了。
佩戴水灵玫瑰时，别忘了将头发梳理得优雅精致，才不辜负这些美丽的花朵。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
White roses with thorns
makes my heart beat with
unceasing trepidation. What
if I prick my finger and shed
blood on its snow white petals?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
带刺的白玫瑰，总让我忐忑不安。
万一刺破手指，让血滴在雪白的花瓣上，该怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
I love roses, but it makes
me sad that their beauty
fades far too soon. And so,
I've found a way to preserve
the beauty of the roses, so
that it lasts for all eternity.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
我爱玫瑰，但它们的美丽消逝得太快，这让我感到悲伤。
因此，我找到了一种方法，可以保留玫瑰的美丽，使其永恒不灭。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Do you love roses as well?
If you like, I can make a
^3131FFMystic Rose^000000 that you can wear
upon your crown. It's not easy
for me to create, but I believe that you would enjoy it greatly.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
您也爱玫瑰吗？
如果您愿意，我可以为您制作一朵^3131FF水灵玫瑰^000000，戴在您的发间。
制作它并不容易，但我相信您会非常喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Please bring me
^3131FF10 2 Carat Diamonds^000000,
^3131FF3 Witherless Roses^000000,
^3131FF1 White Dyestuffs^000000 and
^3131FF50,000 zeny^000000 if you would
like to have a Mystic Rose.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
想要水灵玫瑰的话，请带来：
^3131FF10颗2克拉钻石^000000，
^3131FF3朵永恒玫瑰^000000，
^3131FF1个白色染料^000000，
以及^3131FF50,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
White roses with thorns
makes my heart beat with
unceasing trepidation. What
if I prick my finger and shed
blood on its snow white petals?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
带刺的白玫瑰，总让我忐忑不安。
万一刺破手指，让血滴在雪白的花瓣上，该怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Hmmm...?
What? Did you
need something?
scripts.translation:
[神情悠闲的女士]
嗯...？
怎么，有事吗？

scripts.text: N-Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没...没什么

scripts.text: Um, you look so relaxed.
scripts.translation: 那个，您看起来很悠闲

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Huh.
Alright then.
Well, try not to stare
at people so much.
scripts.translation:
[神情悠闲的女士]
哦，那好吧。
不过，别总盯着别人看。

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Really? You are probably
the twentieth person to
tell me that today. Mmm.
That's strange, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[神情悠闲的女士]
是吗？
你大概是今天第20个这么说的人了。
嗯，真奇怪，对吧？

scripts.text: I guess.
scripts.translation: 我想是吧

scripts.text: It's not strange at all.
scripts.translation: 一点也不奇怪

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Oh yeah.
What's your name?
That is, if you don't
mind me asking you.
scripts.translation:
[神情悠闲的女士]
哦，对了，你叫什么名字？
如果你不介意我问的话。

[{0}]
我叫{1}，是一名冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Oh, one of those?
My name is Achiha, nice
to meet you. I don't really
do much of anything.
Just sit. Relax.
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
哦，原来是冒险者啊。
我叫阿千叶，很高兴认识你。
我平时没什么事做，就坐着，放松放松。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
I do have a hobby,
though. Once in a while,
I'll sew a hat. Do you think
an adventurer like you would
want to have a hat I made?
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
不过我确实有个爱好。
偶尔我会缝制帽子。
你觉得像你这样的冒险者，会想要一顶我做的帽子吗？

scripts.text: Er, I dunno.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我不知道

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Mm. I mean, the
Red Bonnets I make
might not be sturdy
enough for battles.
But what about those
fish and cake hats?
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
嗯，我是说，我做的红色无边软帽，可能不够结实，不适合打仗。
可那些鱼形帽子、蛋糕帽子又怎么算呢？

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Hats...?
That look like
fish or cake? Mm.
Haha. I just got it.
That's, that's funny.
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
帽子...？
做得像鱼，或者蛋糕？
嗯，哈哈，我才反应过来。
真、真好笑。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Really? Well, I can sew
together a ^0000FFRed Bonnet^000000.
It reminds most people
of a baby's bonnet, but
it does look good on
most people I know.
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
真的吗？
那我可以缝一顶^0000FF红色无边软帽^000000。
很多人觉得它像婴儿帽，不过我认识的人戴起来，大都挺好看的。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Um, did you want me
to make you one? I can
go ahead and do it if you
bring me some materials.
Since it's just for fun,
I won't ask for too much.
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
嗯，你想让我给你做一顶吗？
如果你带些材料来，我可以开始做。
既然只是玩玩，我不会要求太多。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Just bring
^0000FF1 Green Lace^000000,
^0000FF1 Silk Ribbon^000000,
^0000FF1 Scarlet Dyestuffs^000000,
^0000FF1 Sunday Hat^000000 and
^0000FF50,000 zeny^000000.

[Achiha]
I think I'm going
to just sit and relax
a little bit longer. But
if you want me to make
a hat for you, come back
with those materials, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
我想再坐一会儿，放松放松。
如果想让我做帽子，就带着这些材料回来吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Oh, hello.
Isn't it such a nice,
quiet, pleasant day?
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
哦，你好。
今天天气真好，安静又舒适，不是吗？

scripts.text: Indeed.
scripts.translation: 确实

scripts.text: Would you please make a hat for me?
scripts.translation: 请给我做一顶帽子好吗？

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Yeah. Today would
be a nice day for a
picnic or a long stroll.
But all I want to do is
just sit and relax...
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
是啊，今天很适合野餐，或者出去慢慢散步。
不过，我只想坐着，歇一歇...

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
What are you talking
about? Oh, you mean the
Red Bonnet? Well, I guess
I can make one. But I think
I need some materials first.
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
你说什么？
哦，红色无边软帽啊？
可以做一顶，不过得先有材料才行。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
^0000FF1 Green Lace^000000,
^0000FF1 Silk Ribbon^000000,
^0000FF1 Scarlet Dyestuffs^000000,
^0000FF1 Sunday Hat^000000 and
^0000FF50,000 zeny^000000.
That's what I need.

[Achiha]
Oh, but I don't
feel like making it
right now. I'm soooo
tired. Let me just sit,
relax, even if it's just
a little while longer...
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
不过，现在不太想做。
我好累啊，就让我再坐着歇一会儿...一小会儿就好...

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Oh, good, you're here.
I've been waiting for you.
Did you bring everything that
you need to make a ^0000FFRed Bonnet^000000?
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
哦，太好了，你来了。
我一直在等你。
你带来制作^0000FF红色无边软帽^000000所需的所有东西了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: I forgot what I need.
scripts.translation: 我忘了需要什么

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Uh oh.
You forgot
a couple things.
Would you like me
to remind you what
you need to bring?
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
哎呀。
你忘了几样东西。
你想让我提醒你需要带什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
^0000FF1 Green Lace^000000,
^0000FF1 Silk Ribbon^000000,
^0000FF1 Scarlet Dyestuffs^000000,
^0000FF1 Sunday Hat^000000 and
^0000FF50,000 zeny^000000. Come back
when you're ready, okay?

[Achiha]
Oh, you brought
everything. That's
good. Okay, just give
it to me. Um, let's see.
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
哦，都带齐了，真好。
那就交给我吧。
嗯，让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Well, I'm finished.
^333333*Yawn*^000000 And now I'm
even more tired. Here,
take this Red Bonnet.
I hope you like it~
I think I'll relax now...
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
好了，做完了。
^333333*哈欠*^000000这下更累了。
拿着，你的红色无边软帽。
希望你喜欢~
我要休息了...

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
I hope you will enjoy the hat~
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
希望你能喜欢这顶帽子~

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Oh, you really
forgot? Oh dear,
let me try to remember.
I didn't forget too, did I?
Oh next;, I remember now...
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
哦，你真的忘了？
哎呀，让我想想。
我自己没忘吧？
哦对了，我想起来了...

scripts.text:

^0000FF1 Green Lace^000000,
^0000FF1 Silk Ribbon^000000,
^0000FF1 Scarlet Dyestuffs^000000,
^0000FF1 Sunday Hat^000000 and

[Achiha]
Oh, I remember you.
You're the adventurer
who likes my Red Bonnets
so much. Did you want me
to make another one for you?
scripts.translation:
[阿千叶]
哦，我想起来了。
你是那个很喜欢我的红色无边软帽的冒险者。
你想让我再给你做一顶吗？

[Zealotus]
Kneel, worm!
As ruler of this
Underground Prison,
I command all who step
into my private realm!
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
跪下，蝼蚁！
我是这座地下监狱的统治者，凡踏入我的领地者，都得听我号令！

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Resist, and you shall be
punished! Grovel and kiss
my feet, and perhaps you
might be spared. Hohohohoho!
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
胆敢反抗，就等着受罚！
趴下亲吻我的脚，也许还能饶你一命。
Hohohohoho!

scripts.text: Oh, your highness!
scripts.translation: 哦，殿下！

scripts.text: Whatever.
scripts.translation: 随便吧

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
The submissive woman is
nothing but an ideal dream
for the arrogant male! A true
woman revels in her power to
have her man do her bidding!
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
顺从的女性不过是傲慢男性的理想幻梦！
真正的女性会享受让男人听命于己的力量！

scripts.text: Yes, it's so true!
scripts.translation: 没错，太对了！

scripts.text: Boooo!

[Zealotus]
However, in my lust for power, I may have inadventently crushed
the spirits of my beloved a little too harshly. His pride crumbled,
my man even cowers in front of the humans! It pains me to see it.
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
不过，或许是太渴望掌控一切，我一不留神，把心爱之人的意志摧残得太狠了。
他的骄傲荡然无存，如今竟连人类都怕！
看着真让我心痛。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
It is beneath me to ask
this of you, but it will take
a human like you to make
him remember who he truly is,
a proud creature of darkness
who should fear only me!
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
向你开口有失身份，可只有你这样的人类，才能让他记起自己的本性。
他可是骄傲的黑暗生物，本来只该畏惧我一个！

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Human. I offer you a small
share of my power if you can
take the pathetic, weeping lump
of monster crying in the corner
of this prison and make him
realize his true nature.
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
人类，监狱角落里有个蜷缩着哭哭啼啼的窝囊魔物。
你若能让他认清自己的本性，我就分一点力量给你。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
You dirty, dirty human...
How dare you have an 
opinion different than mine!
No matter. The day will come
when all of your race shall
address me only as "queen."
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
肮脏的人类...
竟敢跟我意见相左！
无妨，终有一天，你们全族都得尊称我为“女王”。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Mortal simpleton!
Bah! The mocking of
a boorish cur is worthless
to me. I have all the time in
the world to grind your pride
to dust beneath my heels.
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
愚蠢的凡人！
哼！粗俗之徒的嘲讽对我毫无价值。
我有的是时间，将你的骄傲在我的脚下碾成尘土。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Hm. If my beloved is
acting stubborn or refuses
to listen, feel free to take
drastic measures. Just think
of what I would do in your
place. Ohohohohoho~!
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
嗯，我的爱人若是犯倔、不听话，就尽管用些狠招。
想想换作是我，会怎么做。
Ohohohohoho~!

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Ooh, you're back.
Phendark is certainly
back to his old self again,
thanks to your efforts, human.
Yes, his anger, his courage
and passion are all restored~
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
哦，回来了。
多亏你出力，芬达克总算恢复了原来的样子，人类。
他的怒火、勇气和激情，全都回来了~

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
As I promised, I shall
grant you a share of my
power. However, I will need
some items to form this minor
contract between you and me.
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
如我所承诺的，我将分给你一部分我的力量。
不过，我需要一些物品来缔结你与我之间的这份小契约。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
I will need
^3131FF1 Cat's Eye^000000,
^3131FF1 Forbidden Red Candle^000000 and
^3131FF30 Worn-Out Magic Scrolls^000000.
Then, I can grant you a measure
of my power as I've promised.
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
我需要：
^3131FF1个猫眼石^000000，
^3131FF1根红色蜡烛^000000，
以及^3131FF30张老旧魔法图^000000。
到时便能履行承诺，分给你一些力量。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
I see that you have
brought what I need to
complete the contract
between you and me,
human. Let's begin...
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
看来你带来了完成你我之间契约所需的物品，人类。
让我们开始吧...

scripts.text:
^3355FFZealotus takes the red
candle you've given her and
drips the wax into her open
palm. The Cat's Eye begins
to glow with an eerie light.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF泽洛图斯接过你给的红色蜡烛，将蜡滴在她摊开的手掌上。
猫眼石开始散发出诡异的光芒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Now, place your index
finger into my palm so
that we may complete the
final step of this contract...
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
现在，把食指放在我的掌心，完成契约的最后一步...

scripts.text: Don't complete the contract.
scripts.translation: 不缔结契约

scripts.text: Complete the contract.
scripts.translation: 缔结契约

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Hm? What are you
afraid of? This is a
minor contract, so
you are not selling me
your soul, or anything
else for that matter.
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
嗯？怕什么？
这只是个小小的契约，又不是要你把灵魂或别的什么卖给我。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
I, Zealotus, as ruler
of this realm, seal this
eternal contract with this
Forbidden Red Candle.
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
我，泽洛图斯，以此地统治者之名，用这根红色蜡烛缔结永恒的契约。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
{0} will
forever have a share
in my power. Those that
bow to me must also bow
to {1}. It shall be done.
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
{0}将永远分享我的力量。
那些向我俯首者，也必须向{1}俯首。
就此生效。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Human, take this
mask with you as an
everlasting token of our
contract. So long as you
carry this, I will be at your
side. So says Zealotus!
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
人类，带上这个面具，作为我们契约的永恒信物。
只要你带着它，我就会在你身边。
泽洛图斯如是说！

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
I will need
^3131FF1 Cat's Eye^000000,

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Ah, I greet you in
peace, human. Behold,
the splendor of our realm!
Though, I do not blame you
if you have no interest in
commanding these Injustices...
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
啊，人类，愿你平安。
看看我们这片领地，多么辉煌！
不过，你若没兴趣使唤这些邪恶使者，我也不怪你...

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Thanks to your help,
my Phendark has returned
to his old, monstrously
passionate ways. Now I can
show him the stinging love
of my whip! Hohohohohoho!
scripts.translation:
[泽洛图斯]
多亏你帮忙，我的芬达克又像从前那样，热情得像头猛兽了。
这下又能用鞭子，让他尝尝我火辣辣的爱！
Hohohohohoho!

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Huh? Oh no!
Another h-human?!
P-please! S-stay away,
don't come near me!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
什...什么？！
又...又来人类了？！
求...求你！别靠近我，离我远点！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]

P-please! S-stay away,
don't come near me!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
什...什么？！
又...又来人类了？！
求...求你！别靠近我，离我远点！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I... I swear!
I'm not carrying any
rare items or stuff you
can wear, so please don't
beat me! I... Oh my god, you
don't believe me, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
我...我发誓！
我身上没有稀有物品，也没有能穿戴的装备，求你别打我！
我...天哪，你不相信，是不是？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
You humans never leave
me alone! Why do you have
to bully me like this?! I'm
honestly not carrying anything
of value! Z-Zealotus, please!
Zealotus, heeeeeelp me~!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
你们人类从来都不放过我！
为什么非要这样欺负我？！
我真的没带什么值钱的东西！
泽...泽洛图斯，求你了！
泽洛图斯，救救我~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're pathetic!
Aren't you supposed
to be a monster? You know
what Zealotus would do if
she were actually here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你真丢人！
你不是魔物吗？
你知道如果泽洛图斯真的在这里，她会怎么做吗？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
^333333*Sniff...*^000000
P-probably...
Probably whip me.

^3355FFYou nonchalantly^000000
^3355FFbrandish your Whip.^000000

[{0}]
That's right.

^3355FF*Snap!*
*Snap!*
*Crack crack crack!*
*Snap snap snap crack!*^000000

[Phendark]
Oh! That stinging pain
that burns with bloodlust!
It's almost as good as
Zealtos's whip of love!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
哦！这灼热的刺痛，让嗜血的欲望燃烧起来了！
简直快比得上泽洛图斯的爱之鞭了！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Zealotus...
She must be pissed
at me, but I just can't
stop being afraid of all
you humans! Damn it all!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
泽洛图斯...
她肯定在生我的气，但我就是忍不住害怕你们这些人类！
该死啊！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Y-you again!
Why do you hound me?!
Th-there's nothing I can
give you, so please don't
hurt me! Oh, oh p-please...!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
又...又是你！
你为什么非要纠缠我？！
我...我没有什么能给你的，求求你别伤害我！
求求你...别这样...

scripts.text: Feed him Dark Crystal Fragment.
scripts.translation: 喂他黑色水晶碎片

scripts.text: Threaten him.
scripts.translation: 威胁他

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
What...? You want
me to eat these?
It doesn't seem natural,
but if Rybio says I should,
it might not be that bad.
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
什么...？让我吃这个？
总觉得怪怪的，不过既然里比奥这么说，也许没那么糟。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
What's supposed to
happen now? My inner
demon is supposed to
awaken by eating these?
That sounds ridiculous!
Though, I did just eat crystal.
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
接下来会发生什么？
吃了这些，我体内的恶魔就会觉醒吗？
这听起来太荒谬了！
不过，我刚才确实吃了水晶。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Wh-whoa. Ugh!
My chest! Something's
burning inside! I c-can't--!
Can't think straight... I'm...
Slowly... Losing my humanity!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
哇、哇啊！呃！
我的胸口！
里面烧起来了！
我、我没法...脑子不听使唤了...
我正在...一点点...失去人性！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Huh... Huuurg--!
Huk-huk! Heeeeh!
Heeeeeh! Waaoooooh!
scripts.translation:

Huh... Huuurg--!

scripts.text:

...

scripts.translation:

...

scripts.text:

^333333*Pant pant*^000000
What... just...
What happened?

[{0}]

scripts.text:

Just--Just stop it!
scripts.translation:

停...停下！
求你...求你停下！

scripts.text:

Humans...
They're everywhere!
You guys--I can't...
You're torturing me!
scripts.translation:

人类...
到处都是！
你们这些家伙...我受不了...
你们这是在折磨我！

scripts.text:

My chest was on fire,
like I was, I dunno,
burning with anger or
something. It's gone
now, but what were
those crystals?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
刚才胸口像烧起来了一样，就像...怎么说呢，怒火中烧之类的。
现在没事了，不过那些水晶到底是什么？

scripts.text:

You again? Oh no,
you're not going to hurt
me or make me eat those
weird crystals again, are you?
scripts.translation:

又是你？天哪，你不会又要伤害我，或者逼我吃那些奇怪的水晶吧？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I don't think
congratulations are
in order, but I guess
that's good news to hear.
Still, what a surprise!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
好像也没什么值得恭喜的，不过算是个好消息吧。
真是没想到！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
[{0}]
First of all,
what exactly sets
you apart from all the
other eligible monsters
that she can choose from?
Not like you're much better...
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
喂...！
这种事，我可不想听！
[{0}]
先说说，她能选的魔物多了，你到底有什么特别？
你也没比别人强多少吧...

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
[{0}]
I...
I was just kidding!
How could she hate
somebody like you?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
喂...！
这种事，我可不想听！
[{0}]
我...我只是开玩笑！
她怎么可能讨厌你呢？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
嘿...！
我可不想听这种事！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I can't believe
something like that!
Oh, that doesn't matter.
Zealotus is too good for me.
I'm not even worthy of tasting
the sting of her Love Whip.
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
我简直不敢相信！
哦，这并不重要。
泽洛图斯对我来说太优秀了。
我甚至不配品尝她爱之鞭的刺痛。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......
Hates me?
N-no, that can't--
I didn't, that doesn't--
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
...
......
憎恨我？
不...不可能——
我没有，那不可能——

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Huh...?
What is that
supposed to mean?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
嗯...？
这是什么意思？

scripts.text: Insult him.
scripts.translation: 侮辱他

scripts.text: Apologize.
scripts.translation: 道歉

scripts.text:
[{0}]
First of all,
what exactly sets
you apart from all the
other eligible monsters
that she can choose from?
Not like you're much better...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

你也没比别人强多少吧...

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......
Break his pride.
scripts.translation: 打击他的自尊心

scripts.text: Tell him you were joking.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你在开玩笑

scripts.text:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
I mean, there are guys
like Bloody Murderer out
there who are more evil
than you, and best of all,
not afraid of humans!
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
我是说，外面有像嗜血怪人那样比你更邪恶的家伙，而且最重要的是，他们不怕人类！

scripts.text: Go for the low blow.
scripts.translation: 进行人身攻击

scripts.text: Try to salvage his confidence.
scripts.translation: 试图挽回他的自信

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know, me and Zealotus
were actually talking about
you recently. She told me that
the sight of you makes her
feel sick! I mean, what kind
of monster is afraid of humans?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我最近跟泽洛图斯聊过你。
她说一看到你就觉得恶心！
也是，哪有魔物会怕人类的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now you've reached the
point where even Injustice
is manlier than you now,
if you know what I mean!
Hahahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如今就连邪恶使者都比你像个男人了，懂我意思吧！
Hahahahahahahahaha!

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......

[Phendark]
GRRRRRR!
THAT'S ENOUGH!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
GRRRRRR!
够了！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I don't care who the
hell she is, I'm going
to see Zealotus and give
that tramp a piece of my
mind! Grrrr! She'll be sorry!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
管她是什么人，我这就去找泽洛图斯，非好好骂那个贱人一顿不可！
Grrrr!
要让她知道后悔！

scripts.text:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
But know that I think
about it, maybe you look
much tougher than that
Bloody Murderer guy.
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
不过话说回来，也许你看起来比那个嗜血怪人还要凶悍。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
*Sniff sniff*
You really think so?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
*吸鼻子*
你...真的这么觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Yeeeeeah.

[{0}]
But now that I think
about it, you actually
are much better than all
those other monsters.
That stuff I said before?
I was just kidding you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过仔细想想，你其实比那些魔物都要强得多。
我刚才说的话？
我只是在逗你玩。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
^333333*Sniff!*^000000
You're...
Not helping!

[{0}]
I...
I was just kidding!
How could she hate
somebody like you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...
我只是在开玩笑！
她怎么可能讨厌像你这样的人呢？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
No... No.
You're right.
I don't deserve love.
Not from Zealotus or
from anybody else...
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
不...不。
你说得对。
我不配得到爱。
无论是来自泽洛图斯还是其他人...

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Zealotus! How dare
she say those things
against me! Less manly
than Injustice?! I'll just
have to prove her wrong!
Out the way, pithy human!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
泽洛图斯！
竟敢这么说我！
连邪恶使者都比我像个男人？！
我非让她知道自己错了不可！
滚开，渺小的人类！

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
You know, I usually just
run up and slash like crazy
once I see you humans, but
my heart's not in it today, so
I'm gonna give you just one
chance to run for your life.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
平时一看见你们人类，我早就冲上去一通乱砍了。
不过今天没那个心情，就给你一次逃命的机会。

scripts.text: Talk about Phendark.
scripts.translation: 谈谈芬达克

scripts.text: Run for your life.
scripts.translation: 逃命

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
What th--? You know the
same Phendark I know?
Dayam, that's weird. But
yeah, him and Zealotus have
some kind of... I dunno what
it is, actually. Um, love?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
什么鬼...？你认识的也是那个芬达克？
靠，还真稀奇。
不过，他跟泽洛图斯是有那么点...其实我也说不清。
呃，爱情？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Anyway, Phendark has
been acting really weird
lately. I guess Zealotus
loved him to the point that
she abused him to the point
that he's scared of humans now.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
反正芬达克最近怪得很。
我猜泽洛图斯爱他爱得太狠，下手也太重，结果把他折磨得连人类都怕了。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Huh. You know what'd help?
Dark Crystal Fragments. It's
worthless to humans, but if
creatures of darkness eat it,
it brings out more of their
inner demon. Scary, huh?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
知道什么能帮上忙吗？
黑色水晶碎片。
对人类没什么用，可黑暗生物吃了，就能激发出更多魔性。
吓人吧？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Since Phendark's pretty big, and he's acting like a total wuss, you
you should probably get him to eat ^3131FF369 Dark Crystal Fragments^000000. Don't
worry, you should be able to find those all over Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
既然芬达克体型很大，而且表现得像个胆小鬼，你应该让他吃^3131FF369个黑色水晶碎片^000000。
别担心，你应该能在米德加尔特各地找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
I dunno why a human
like you would want to
help one of us out, though.
What's in it for you, exactly?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
不过，我搞不懂像你这样的人类为什么会想帮助我们。
你到底图什么？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
That's right!
Run, get outta here!
If you're not fast enough,
I might eat you, human!
...Well... Probably not.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
没错！
快跑，赶紧离开这里！
如果你跑得不够快，我可能会吃掉你，人类！
...嗯...大概不会吧。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
I don't get why someone
like you, a seemingly heroic
adventurer, would want to help
out Phendark? Did Zealotus
blackmail you or something?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
我不明白像你这样看似英勇的冒险者，为什么要帮助芬达克？
是泽洛图斯威胁你了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Well, you could
probably help him
by getting him to eat
^3131FF369 Dark Crystal Fragments^000000
to sort of stir up the demon
that sleeping within, you know?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
嗯，让他吃下^3131FF369个黑色水晶碎片^000000，也许就能唤醒体内沉睡的恶魔。
这么说，你明白吧？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Feeding him all of those
Dark Crystal Fragments didn't
work? But that was supposed
to be foolproof! Dayam, what
the hell happened to Phendark's
inner demon?! Man oh man...
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
吃了那么多黑色水晶碎片都没用？
本来应该万无一失的啊！
靠，芬达克体内的恶魔到底出什么事了？！
真见鬼...

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Well, I don't know what
else you could try. I mean,
maybe you could try motivating
him. Reverse psychology?
It's weird talking about this
with a human. Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
我也不知道还能怎么办了。
也许试着刺激他一下？
用用激将法？
跟人类商量这些，还真够怪的。
Hahahaha~

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Phendark sure looks
tough, but I guess even
he isn't totally evil. Yeah.
We monsters aren't all
bad... Just mostly bad.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
芬达克看起来很凶悍，但我想他也不是完全邪恶的。是的。
我们魔物不全是坏的...只是大部分很坏。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Oh man...
It's almost lunchtime,
but he hasn't come by
yet. Where could h--Oh!
Hello, welcome to Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
唉...
都快午饭时间了，他怎么还没来？
人到底在哪...哦！
你好，欢迎来到艾音布罗克~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Wait a sec, that
Crunch Toast! You must
be the guy who helped out
my buddy, Kasis. I owe you
my gratitude since without your help, I wouldn't eat lunch!
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
等一下，那个土司！
你一定是帮助了我朋友卡西斯的那个人。
我很感激你，因为如果没有你的帮助，我就没饭吃了！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
It sounds like Kasis
has been having business
troubles lately, but I'm sure
he'll weather it out. I just don't know what's taking him so long
to get here. I'm sooo hungry!
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
听说卡西斯最近的生意出了些麻烦，不过我相信他一定能挺过去。
就是不知道他怎么这么久还不来。
饿死我了！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
By any chance, are you
heading to Juno? I have
a favor to ask if you're
going there. Or did you
need help finding your
way around this city?
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
请问，你是要去朱诺吗？如果你要去的话，我有件事想拜托你。
或者你需要我帮你在这座城市里找路吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I'm heading to Juno.
scripts.translation: 没错，我要去朱诺

scripts.text: I need help finding my way around!
scripts.translation: 我需要帮忙找路！

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Well, if you're going to
Juno and you're not busy,
would you visit a pastry
chef named Kasis for me?
He's an old friend and I'm
a little worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
嗯，如果你要去朱诺而且不忙的话，能帮我拜访一下名叫卡西斯的糕点厨师吗？
他是我的老朋友，我有点担心他。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Usually, he sends us
lunches around this time
without fail, but since lunch
hasn't arrived yet, I can't help but wonder, ''What happened?''
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
平时这个点，他肯定已经把午餐送来了，可今天到现在还没动静。
我忍不住担心，是不是出了什么事？

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Of course, I'd be lying if
I said my hunger didn't factor
into my concern for his welfare. Anyway, if you have the time,
you can find Kasis in Juno's
Bakery. Thanks, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
当然，要说关心他的安危完全不是因为肚子饿，那就是撒谎了。
总之，有空就去朱诺的面包店找找卡西斯吧。
谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
First of all, if you
go just outside of the
Airport, you can find
Guides that can tell you
about all the important
places of interest in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
先说说找路吧，出了机场，就能找到向导。
他们会告诉你艾音布罗克各处重要地点的位置。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Now, if you want to take
a rest before or after a
flight on one of the Airships,
you can use the passenger
lounge on the second floor.
It's a good tip to know~
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
乘坐飞空艇之前或之后，要是想歇歇，可以到二楼的候机室去。
记住这点，会方便不少哦~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Did you have any
other questions to ask
me while you're here?
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
你在这里还有别的问题要问我吗？

scripts.text: Can I take a picture with you?
scripts.translation: 能和你合个影吗？

scripts.text: About Einbroch
scripts.translation: 关于艾音布罗克

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Pardon me?
I don't hear that
request often, but
I suppose it couldn't
do any harm to pose
for just one picture.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
啊？
这种请求倒是少见，不过摆个姿势拍一张，也没什么大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Cheese~
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
茄子~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
You know, it's hard to
believe that Einbroch has
become a major industrial
so quickly. I guess it's the
result of the demand for the
ores mined over in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
艾音布罗克居然这么快就成了工业重镇，真是难以置信。
我想，是因为人们对艾音贝赫出产的矿石需求很大吧。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Although Einbech and Einbroch
can't survive without each other, Einbech is in a pretty sorry state
compared to Einbroch. If you've
ever been there, you know what
I mean. It's almost tragic.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
虽然艾音贝赫和艾音布罗克谁也离不开谁，但和艾音布罗克相比，艾音贝赫的状况相当糟糕。
如果你去过那里，你就明白我的意思了。
简直有点令人悲哀。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Most of the prosperity of
this city is attributed to the
productivity of the factories.
But along with great wealth,
these factories have also
brought pollution problems.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
这座城市的繁荣主要归功于工厂的高生产力。
但伴随着巨大的财富，这些工厂也带来了污染问题。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
If you hear the
Smog Alert, you should
run to safety as quickly
as you can! It's dangerous
to be out in the open when
the pollution levels are high!
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
如果你听到烟雾警报，应该尽快跑到安全的地方！
在污染水平高的时候待在户外是很危险的！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Well then, I hope
that you enjoy your
travels here in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
那么，希望你在艾音布罗克的旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Have a good time in
Einbroch, adventurer.
I hope you enjoy your
travels here in the
Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
祝你在艾音布罗克玩得开心，冒险者。
希望你在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的旅行愉快。
